notes.title: Public Playtest for Plagueborn Coming Soon!
notes.content:
[p][b]Welcome to the Official Plagueborn Steam Page![/b][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]We’re incredibly excited to finally welcome you to the official Steam hub for [i]Plagueborn[/i]! This has been a passion project over 2 years in the making, and we couldn’t be more thrilled to start sharing it with all of you.[/p][p][i]Plagueborn[/i] is a 2D co-op action-adventure RPG with roguelike elements, set in a world ravaged by a mysterious plague. You’ll battle through corrupted lands, uncover lost secrets, and forge your path with powerful weapons, passives, and relics—alone or with friends.[/p][p]Over the past 2 years, we've been hard at work building the core systems, including:[/p][list][*][p]Online multiplayer (up to 10 players!)[/p][/*][*][p]Procedurally generated dungeons[/p][/*][*][p]14 UNIQUE weapons[/p][/*][*][p]An evolving passive and gear system[/p][/*][*][p]Intense boss battles[/p][/*][*][p]A deep meta-progression system[/p][/*][*][p]And lots of grim, handcrafted pixel art![/p][/*][/list][p]But now it’s time for the next phase...[/p][p]ːsteamhappyː [b]The first public playtest is coming in Q4 2025![/b] ːsteamhappyː
This will be your chance to jump in with friends and help shape the future of [i]Plagueborn[/i]. We’ll be looking for feedback, bug reports, and wishlist warriors—so if you’re hyped, smash that wishlist button and stay tuned![/p][p]Thank you all for being here from the start. We can’t wait to show you what’s next.[/p][p]— [i]Bruhdders[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150835/ba8b2bb287d2fdd4b504b9a8eb2607e68d4add68.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150835/14a3180e015011e599c210ef3b847bd0bf309209.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150835/31196a316f63fd212f143dde5cfebb9c18944ac3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150835/fa1dd40ce2e8b955d9f8c5b84d0e47efec17ac77.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150835/0dd8500a397542452654cf8a87d92ffd3cbdd5e6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150835/7339a2576a0e780e8f258904826d91f583a7053c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150835/d1cbb3edcbacaabf85ee803add0d5c18a835cb1b.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45150835/e216ecb02d8a578ce94b2f44a88de2034e487aa5.png"][/img][/p]
